title: 3.4 Evaluation — the skill that most separates seniors from juniors
description: Roadmap 3.4 — 10 topics, in the document's own order.
learningOutcomes: Take every topic in this section to pass 3 of the roadmap's rule: intuition, then derived on paper, then implemented from scratch.

lessons.title: ROC-AUC vs PR-AUC — and why PR-AUC is correct for imbalanced problems
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion
